gloss: outside (a range or limit); beyond; not covered by

definitions.gloss: outside (a range or limit); not covered by
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a noun naming a range, a period or a category and means outside it: {予想外|よそうがい} (beyond expectation), {時間外|じかんがい} (outside hours), {対象外|たいしょうがい} (not covered). It is productive, so new compounds are easy to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧だった。
{営業時間外|えいぎょうじかんがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つながらない。
examples.english: Calls don't go through outside business hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象外|たいしょうがい}→対象外：10019_taishougai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: This item isn't eligible for the discount, so you have to pay full price.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix follows the noun it limits and is read がい. The same character as a prefix ({外|がい}〜: ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧, ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧) means "foreign, outer" instead.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧: unexpected
- ⟦{時間外|じかんがい}→時間外：26570_jikangai⟧: outside (working) hours
- ⟦{対象外|たいしょうがい}→対象外：10019_taishougai⟧: not covered, not eligible
- ⟦{範囲外|はんいがい}→範囲外：28213_hanigai⟧: out of range, out of scope
- ⟦{専門外|せんもんがい}→専門外：26018_senmongai⟧: outside one's field
- ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧: out of range (of a phone signal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧: other than, except — a separate word, the usual way to exclude something after any noun (⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧: every day but Sunday); 〜{外|がい} is the compact suffix of fixed compounds
- 〜⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧: within — the opposite suffix ({時間内|じかんない}, ⟦{範囲内|はんいない}→範囲内：25429_haninai⟧)
